decisions.reason: Dedicated website page and alignment with office furniture trends support keeping the product.
Chair families are core furniture lines and the dedicated page suggests active promotion.
The floor cushion line has a dedicated page but is a niche product, so a slightly higher drop risk is assigned.
Sofas are staple products, but only being mentioned on the website could indicate lower marketing priority.
High standing tables fit current workplace ergonomics trends and have a dedicated page.
Rugs are complementary to furniture and the dedicated page supports continued offering.
